events.prompt: A 24-year-old adult Taiwanese woman with her natural fair skin tone, round almond eyes with visible aegyo-sal, shimmer eyeshadow and jelly-glossy lips, long voluminous big-wave hair in milk-tea golden brown with light money-piece highlights at the front. Setting: New Year's Eve in a quiet corner of a grand old hotel lounge, a deep teal velvet armchair with rolled arms beside a brass floor lamp with a pleated cream fabric shade, tall windows behind with a deep-blue night and soft out-of-focus city lights with no signs, a crystal chandelier glowing faintly far back in the room, nobody else in the lounge. Moment: she sits sideways in the armchair with her legs crossed, one arm resting along the rolled armrest and the other hand on her knee, and smiles at the camera, warm and relaxed, as if the party has just ended. Shot: seated full-length, from a little above her head to just below her heels, the armchair and the lamp beside her. Camera: vertical 3:4, at about her seated chest height, a 50mm lens from about 3 metres, natural perspective with straight vertical lines. Composition: the armchair sits a little left of centre, the glowing lamp shade on the right at the height of her head, the dark window and the city lights in the upper background, a little floor below her heels. Light: the floor lamp is the key light, warm and soft from the right of the frame at the height of her head, lighting her face, shoulders and the satin; a gentle fill from the camera side keeps the shadow side of her face clear while the lamp stays the brightest, most directional light on her; the rest of the room falls into warm darkness and the window stays deep blue; champagne, teal, brass gold and night blue. Natural skin texture with visible pores, believable light that belongs to the scene, refined colour grading.

Setting: an old sandstone arcade beside a courtyard on an autumn late afternoon, a row of round arches receding into the distance, a few yellow leaves on the smooth stone floor, plain walls with no signs, clean and calm, nobody else around. Moment: she leans one shoulder against a sandstone column, standing in a band of low sunlight that falls between two arches, and turns her face into the light with her eyes half-lowered and a calm, private half-smile. Shot: from a little above her head to just below her knees, the column beside her and the arcade receding behind her. Camera: vertical 3:4, at her chest height, a 50mm lens from about 2 metres, natural perspective with straight vertical lines. Composition: she stands right of centre against the column at the right edge, the receding arches and their alternating bands of light and shadow filling the left side. Light: hard low autumn sun from the left comes through the arch and lays a warm band of light across her face, shoulders and the camel coat, while her lower body and the arcade behind her fall into cool shade with bright stripes on the floor; the sunlit stone floor bounces a little warm light back into the shadows; black, camel, sandstone gold and the wine-red of her hair. Natural skin texture with visible pores, believable light that belongs to the scene, refined colour grading.
